purpose: Reproduce algebraic certificates and try to falsify implementation/theorem boundary handling; numerical experiments do not prove universal claims.
enumeration: N=2,...,10; all fold values, coalescence, one point between successive thresholds and above coalescence; verify all representatives by independent first-order residual and Hessian eigenvalues.
learning: 72 seeded heterogeneous instances; N in 2,3,4,6,9,12; gamma in 0.1,0.5,1; sigma_i log-uniform from 0.05 to 5; a uniform from -8 to 8; initial closed loop uniform in [-0.8,0.8]/sqrt(gamma). Maximum 10000 cycles; residual target 1e-9.
failure_policy: Report every nonconvergence, feasibility failure, descent violation above roundoff or failed identity; do not silently remove samples or change acceptance criteria after seeing outputs.
